description: This file contains utility functions and classes for various common authentication and authorization checks within the Litellm proxy service. It includes functions for handling JWT tokens, API keys, budget checks, model access permissions, route validation, and access to related database objects such as users, teams, organizations, tags, and permissions. Additionally, it provides utility functions for caching, budget management, and role-based permissions within the proxy infrastructure.
